topic: Dad's first time doing bedtime and it all falls apart
video_title: Dad does bedtime and it falls apart? Same page fix
caption:
Dad did bedtime for the first time and it all fell apart. We're not on the same page.

Ages 1-6 years thrive on a regular bedtime routine (AAP).
Agree on ONE routine together: brush, book, bed, at the same time every night.
In a trial of children aged 7-36 months, 2 weeks of a steady routine meant falling asleep faster and fewer night wakings.
